clue.text: Victims of loose links

parts.note: loose in the sense of informal or relaxed, as casual is
links or connections, as ties between people

explanation.surface: People harmed by chains whose links have come apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loose links' reads as one physical image, but it is two words making two pieces: informal plus connections.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: people killed or injured in an accident or war are its victims.

clue.text: Do better than expected initially, finding something to wear

parts.note: to cap a story is to go one better than it, to top it

indicators.note: initially says only the opening letter of the word expected is used

explanation.surface: Someone outperforms hopes and stumbles on a garment along the way.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleeveless cloak worn over the shoulders is an item of clothing.

clue.text: Races around Washington, now dismissing new inviolate institution

indicators.note: around signals the letters of races being turned about into a new order

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder
DC, District of Columbia, is the short name for the US capital

indicators.note: dismissing means a letter is sent away from the word now

explanation.surface: Runners speed around the American capital, a tradition nobody dares challenge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' looks like a container signal wrapping Washington, but here it rearranges the race letters; the capital then simply follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: something treated as beyond criticism, like a holy animal, is an untouchable institution.

clue.text: Land in water after a passage

indicators.note: after places the island word behind the letter A in the answer

parts.note: an isle is a piece of land surrounded by water

explanation.surface: Someone comes ashore on an island after a voyage.
explanation.definitionFit: A walkway between rows of seats in a church or theatre is a passage.

clue.text: Lots besieging terribly coy businessmen of great power

indicators.note: besieging means surrounding, so the word for lots goes round the other piece

parts.note: tons is an informal word for lots, a great many

indicators.note: terribly suggests the letters of coy are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: Powerful magnates surround a very shy person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terribly' scrambles the shy word, and 'besieging' has the weight word surround that jumble just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: magnates who wield vast commercial influence are powerful businesspeople.

clue.text: Her date goes and gets grounded

indicators.note: goes in the sense of goes wrong or goes to pieces, so the letters are broken up

explanation.surface: A woman's evening companion leaves and is then forbidden to go out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grounded' looks like a teenager kept in, but here it is the electrical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrical sense: a circuit connected to the ground for safety is said to be earthed.

clue.text: Prison record from the East covering start of action

indicators.note: covering means the turned word goes round the single letter
in an across clue, coming from the East means reading right to left, backwards

parts.note: a log is a written record, as a ship's log

indicators.note: start of says only the first letter of action is taken

explanation.surface: A prison's records, sent from the East, describe how proceedings began.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the East' turns LOG into GOL, which then goes round A.
explanation.definitionFit: British spelling of jail: a gaol is a place of imprisonment.

clue.text: Foreign article admitting fabrication

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so the article holds the falsehood

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a lie is a fabrication, an invented untruth

explanation.surface: A piece of writing from abroad confesses to making things up.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something from another country or quite unfamiliar is described as strange or overseas in origin.

clue.text: To run away before one final check is valid

parts.note: leg it is slang for running off
I is the Roman numeral for one
in chess, checkmate, or mate, is the final check that ends the game

explanation.surface: Fleeing before a last inspection is perfectly acceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something lawful or justifiable is legally sound.

clue.text: Active moves covering right and left upright

indicators.note: covering means the shuffled letters go around the single letter for right
moves suggests the letters of active are shifted into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Lively political moves embrace both right and left while staying principled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moves' turns ACTIVE into VETICA; it covers R, and L follows at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: standing straight up at right angles to the ground is being perpendicular.

clue.text: Legislation on parking agreements

indicators.note: on means the laws word sits next to the parking letter, following it

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking, as on road signs
acts of Parliament are pieces of legislation

explanation.surface: Laws about where cars may park.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: formal deals or treaties between parties are agreements.

clue.text: Dog, for example, during affectionate dressing-down

indicators.note: during means the animal word comes in the middle of the kindly word

parts.note: caring means kind and affectionate
a dog is an example of a pet

explanation.surface: A dog wanders in during a fond moment of getting dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressing-down' looks like putting on clothes; it is a scolding.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: being carpeted means being summoned and reprimanded, a telling-off.

clue.text: The home designed by born monster

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for born, as in biographies

indicators.note: designed means planned or arranged, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A house built by a monstrous creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges THE HOME into EHEMOTH, placed after B; 'by' just joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: A biblical beast, the name now means anything enormous and monstrous.

clue.text: The principle of men being banned from apartment block

indicators.note: being banned from means the males are thrown out of the building word

parts.note: a tenement is a large building divided into flats
taken as written

explanation.surface: The rule that males are not allowed in a block of flats.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a belief or doctrine held as true is a principle.

clue.text: A few drops of the hard stuff?

definitions.text: A few drops of the hard stuff?

parts.words: A few drops of the hard stuff
parts.note: sounds like a nip of spirits, but means frozen pellets falling from the sky

explanation.definitionFit: Hard pellets of ice fall from clouds as solid precipitation in a storm.

clue.text: Marksmen executed demonstrators

indicators.note: executed here means beheaded, so the first letter is cut off

parts.note: marchers are protesters on a demonstration

explanation.surface: Gunmen put protesters to death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'executed' looks like the killing verb but tells you to behead MARCHERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: people who shoot with bows are skilled shooters.

clue.text: Discharge coming from Eastern embassy

parts.note: a diplomatic mission is an embassy

explanation.surface: Someone is released from an embassy in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something given off, as gas from an exhaust, is a discharge.

clue.text: Speak with authority of French demand

parts.note: de is the French word for of
a claim is a demand for something as one's right

explanation.surface: A French claim is spoken with conviction.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to orate rhetorically is to deliver words forcefully and with presence.

clue.text: Hermit's answer — it must be found in new task

indicators.note: must be found in places the little word inside the duty word

parts.note: a chore is a routine task
taken as written

explanation.surface: A recluse replies that the thing must be located within some fresh job.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a religious recluse living apart from the world is a hermit.

clue.text: Fellow worried about international criminal

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go round the extra letter
worried means agitated, so the letters of fellow are shaken up

explanation.surface: A man frets about a criminal from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' turns FELLOW into LOWLFE, which goes round I.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a disreputable person of the underworld is a crook.

clue.text: Voids member with links supporting Spain

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means the later pieces sit beneath the letter for Spain

parts.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain
MP, Member of Parliament
ties are links or connections

explanation.surface: A politician with connections backs Spain, then drains everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to empty is to clear out, to make vacant.

clue.text: Strikingly unauthorised act, perhaps?

parts.note: a walkout by workers without union approval; also wild suggests mixing up the letters of act

explanation.definitionFit: Industrial term: a sudden strike not sanctioned by the union is called this.

clue.text: House turns on Tory with no limits

parts.note: winds means twists or turns

indicators.note: with no limits means the first and last letters of the word Tory are dropped

explanation.surface: A family of rulers comes round to an unrestrained Conservative.
explanation.walkthrough: House here is a royal dynasty, the current British royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: The reigning British royal family is a dynastic house so named since 1917.

clue.text: Credit son getting correct marks

parts.note: on tick means on credit, so tick is credit

explanation.surface: A boy who gets financial credit earns the right grades.
explanation.definitionFit: Ticks are the check symbols a teacher puts beside right answers.

clue.text: Remedy protecting independent physicist

indicators.note: protecting means the treatment word surrounds and shields the single letter

parts.note: a cure is a remedy

explanation.surface: A treatment that shields an unaffiliated scientist.
explanation.definitionFit: Marie Curie was a Nobel-winning scientist who pioneered radioactivity research.

clue.text: Suffering mainly attached to confined military headquarters

indicators.note: attached to joins the trimmed suffering word onto the confined word

parts.note: pent, as in pent-up, means shut in

indicators.note: mainly means most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: agony is suffering

explanation.surface: Most pain is bound up with a closed-off army base.
explanation.definitionFit: The five-sided US Department of Defense building is the American military headquarters.

clue.text: A wheat, perhaps, that has future growth potential?

parts.note: wheat is an example of a corn, a cereal crop

explanation.surface: A grain crop is a sound investment for the years ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: An oak's seed can grow into a mighty tree, so it holds promise of growth.

clue.text: Fellow trapped in the broken lift

indicators.note: trapped in places the single letter inside the scrambled word
broken means the letters of the are smashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A man is stuck in a lift that has broken down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lift' looks like part of the scene but is the definition; 'broken' turns THE into HET, round F.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to heft is to lift or hoist something heavy.

clue.text: Drugs coming from church beset by criminal actions

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded by, so the church letters sit inside
criminal suggests the letters of actions are illicitly rearranged

parts.note: RC, Roman Catholic, stands for a church

explanation.surface: Drugs come out of a church surrounded by illegal deeds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beset by' reads as the church being attacked; it means the church letters sit within the scrambled deeds, which 'criminal' signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: opiates and similar illegal substances are drugs.

clue.text: Put forward work at home before the end of June

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work
in means at home

indicators.note: the end of says only the final letter of June is used

explanation.surface: Propose working from home until late June.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to state an opinion is to offer it for consideration.

clue.text: Great number killed

definitions.meaning: past tense of slay, meaning murdered

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an American informal word for a large amount, and the past tense of slay.

clue.text: Changing trains, chap gets bitter

indicators.note: changing means altering, so the letters of trains are rearranged

parts.note: a gent is a man, a chap

explanation.surface: A man becomes sour after switching railway services.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sharp, harsh or acerbic in taste or manner is caustic.
